A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the results of our research show that teachers' empowerment has positive influence on organizational commitment, professional and organizational citizenship behavior.
teacher empowerment is positively related to teachers’ organizational and PC, and to their engagement in OCBs.
teachers’ perceptions about the extent to which they are empowered in their work environment are significantly related to organizational and PC, and to OCB.
The main takeaway from our work is that

teachers’ empowerment has an impact on their organizational commitment, their professional commitment, and their OCBs, and that the impact of empowerment on OCB is stronger than on the other outcomes.
teachers who feel empowered are more committed to their profession and to their school.
teacher empowerment can be used as a lever to enhance teachers' commitment to their schools and the profession, and their willingness to contribute to the school beyond their formal job requirements.
